dish: horumon moriawase: six cuts chosen from the day's delivery (incl. abura-horumon and heart) in a house tare kept going since the shop opened
address: Nishikujō, Konohana-ku, Osaka (shopping-street horumon-teppan shop; street number not shown by the sources)
w: Horumon teppan-yaki counter opened in 1973 and still run by its elderly founding owner. TV Tokyo's Adomachi Tengoku featured it in the 'six shopping streets' segment of the 2024 Osaka Universal City/Konohana episode, and Time Out Osaka's '8 things to do only in Nishikujō' recommends the horumon moriawase.
